samples.title: Giờ làm linh hoạt
samples.prompt: Invite your friend to a flexible working discussion. Explain what will happen, why your friend might enjoy it, and what they should prepare.
requirementsVi: Mời rõ sự kiện.
Nêu hoạt động, lý do, giờ và nơi.
Dặn chuẩn bị và xin xác nhận.
samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Lời mời
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

I hope you are well. I am writing to invite you to a flexible working discussion at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. It has been a while since we did something together, and I think this would be a useful and enjoyable way to meet.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu lời mời cùng thông tin chính.

paragraphs.label: Lý do tham gia
paragraphs.text: We will compare working schedules and plan shared team hours. The aim is to connect the topic with everyday life rather than only listen to a long talk. One useful point is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. There will also be time to ask questions and exchange ideas with the other people taking part.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị
paragraphs.text: Please bring a sample weekly schedule. We could meet outside the entrance ten minutes before the session starts. You do not need to be an expert; the organiser has said that beginners are welcome. Please tell me at least two days before the session whether you can come so that I can reserve two places.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chuẩn bị, điểm hẹn và hạn phản hồi.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
I really hope you can join me. I am looking forward to hearing what you think.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Kết thân mật và mong gặp.
